name: Exp_Skyscraper_Fix_ColorAML
summary: This EA is a trend-following expert advisor based on the Skyscraper indicator with a fixed ColorAML (Adaptive Moving Average with color coding). It enters long positions when the ColorAML turns bullish and the Skyscraper confirms an upward trend, and enters short positions on bearish ColorAML signals with downward trend confirmation. The system uses a fixed lot size and includes basic stop loss and take profit management.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个基于Skyscraper指标和固定ColorAML（自适应移动平均线带颜色编码）的趋势跟踪专家顾问。当ColorAML转为看涨且Skyscraper确认上升趋势时做多，当ColorAML转为看跌且确认下降趋势时做空。系统使用固定手数，并包含基本的止损和止盈管理。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是趋势跟踪，使用ColorAML自适应移动平均线作为主要趋势方向判断工具，配合Skyscraper指标作为辅助确认。入场条件为ColorAML颜色发生方向性变化（如从下跌色转为上涨色做多），同时Skyscraper指标需确认趋势方向一致才会开仓。出场条件包括触及预设的止盈或止损水平，以及ColorAML颜色反转时也可能触发平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有根据账户余额或波动性动态调整仓位大小的机制。资金管理方面仅依赖固定止损来控制单笔风险，缺乏整体账户风险控制如最大回撤限制或连续亏损保护。整体策略逻辑清晰但较为简单，适合趋势明显的市场环境。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following, utilizing the ColorAML (Adaptive Moving Average with color coding) as the primary trend direction indicator, supplemented by the Skyscraper indicator for confirmation. Entry conditions require the ColorAML to change its color directionally (e.g., from bearish to bullish color for long entries), with the Skyscraper indicator confirming the same trend direction before a position is opened. Exit conditions include hitting preset take-profit or stop-loss levels, and positions may also be closed when the ColorAML color reverses direction. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility. Money management relies solely on fixed stop-loss levels to control per-trade risk, lacking overall account risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits or consecutive loss protection. The overall strategy logic is clear but relatively simple, performing best in strongly trending market conditions.

pros: 策略逻辑清晰简洁，使用双指标确认减少假信号
趋势跟踪策略在强趋势市场中表现良好
使用自适应移动平均线能够动态适应市场变化
代码结构相对简单，便于理解和修改
双指标确认机制提供了一定的过滤效果
pros_en: Clear and concise strategy logic with dual indicator confirmation reducing false signals
Trend following strategy performs well in strongly trending markets
Adaptive Moving Average dynamically adjusts to market changes
Relatively simple code structure easy to understand and modify
Dual indicator confirmation provides some filtering effect
cons: 固定手数缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据账户规模调整风险
没有传播过滤器，在新闻事件或高传播时可能导致滑点
缺乏账户级别的风险控制如最大回撤限制或最大持仓限制
在震荡市中容易产生频繁的假突破信号导致连续亏损
止盈止损为固定点数未考虑市场波动率ATR动态调整
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management unable to adjust risk based on account size
No spread filter which may cause slippage during news events or high spread periods
Lacks account-level risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits or maximum position limits
Prone to frequent false breakout signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Fixed pip stop loss and take profit without ATR-based dynamic adjustment for market volatility
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈机制以适应不同市场波动率
加入仓位管理模块根据账户余额百分比动态计算手数
添加传播过滤器和时间过滤器避免高传播和不利时段交易
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit mechanism to adapt to varying market volatility
Implement position sizing module to dynamically calculate lot size based on account equity percentage
Add spread filter and time filter to avoid trading during high spread and unfavorable sessions

risk_points: 固定手数无法根据账户规模调整风险敞口
缺乏最大回撤和连续亏损保护机制
震荡市中可能产生连续亏损信号
没有传播过滤器可能在不利条件下开仓
risk_points_en: Fixed lot size unable to adjust risk exposure based on account size
Lacks maximum drawdown and consecutive loss protection mechanisms
May generate consecutive losing signals in ranging markets
No spread filter may open positions under unfavorable conditions
